capabilities: Sync vault files live with an Azure Blob Storage container
Merge changes with a three-way comparison and keep conflict copies
Run upload-only backup or download-only mirror sync modes
Sync the .obsidian settings folder with ignore patterns and size limits
Connect by pasting a SAS URL and test list, write, read and delete permissions
extras: The plugin is free, but Microsoft bills the user for storage and requests (stated as typically cents per month). The README includes a detailed Azure setup walkthrough, security notes on SAS tokens, cost estimates, and BRAT installation instructions. The manifest listing notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in sync with a personal Azure Blob Storage container without a third-party server.
summary: Live two-way sync of a vault with the user's own Azure Blob Storage container via a SAS token, with three-way merge and conflict copies.
